components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            present it is used to compose the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for backward
            compatibility; when structured address fields are supplied they take
            precedence. On read it is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended
            when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat address; it is normalized on create
            (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations
            expanded) and the composed address is derived from it.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to the composed address after a single
            space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows the owner to be created even if another owner
            already belongs to the same household (i.e. shares the same last name and
            postcode); the owner is then created as a declared household member and is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate. When false or omitted, such a create is
            rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            validated only when present, stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's optional date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When present it
            is used to derive the owner's ageBand relative to the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as 'title lastName' when a title
                is present, or just the lastName when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by
                spaces. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN
                is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than
                the number of owners at the time the owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M20'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in
                the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the household, the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 of the owner's normalized last name and
                postcode. Owners with the same last name (compared case-insensitively
                with surrounding whitespace trimmed) and postcode are automatically
                assigned the same value.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1b9c4d5e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived duplicate-detection key, formatted as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the email segment is
                empty when the owner has no email. Two owners are considered
                duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3f2a1b9c4d5e'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, computed on creation: starting at 0,
                adding 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 when the
                owner belongs to a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure
                exceeds 365 days since the registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4
                for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration day at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate relative to the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, an existing owner
                shared this owner's lastName and postcode but had a different
                telephone (a soft match that is not a hard duplicate), otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on lastName and
                postcode at creation time, or absent when there was no such match.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true

## Summary

I implemented owner deletion as a soft-delete across the Spring Boot application.

**What changed:**

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — added a `deleted` boolean field (`@Column(name = "deleted")`), defaulting to `false`, with `isDeleted()`/`setDeleted()`.

2. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `deleted` read-only boolean property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it in `GET` responses.

3. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — ignored `deleted` when mapping `OwnerFieldsDto → Owner` (it isn't a client-settable field); the `Owner → OwnerDto` mapping picks it up automatically.

4. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**:
   - `deleteOwner` now sets `deleted = true`, saves the owner (retaining the row), and returns `200 OK` with the owner body instead of removing the record.
   - Added an `activeOwners()` helper (owners not flagged deleted) and routed the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks through it — `rejectDuplicateIdentity`, `rejectDuplicateHousehold`, and `findPossibleDuplicateOf` — so a soft-deleted owner no longer blocks a create.

5. **Schema files** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `deleted` column so the entity maps against the DB (tests run on hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`).

**Behavior now matches the spec:** a new owner reads back `deleted: false`; `DELETE /api/owners/{id}` returns 2xx and flags it deleted while retaining the record; `GET` still returns the owner with `deleted: true`; and a normally-blocking duplicate is allowed when the only matching owner has been soft-deleted. Both new acceptance tests (`coreSoftDeleteFlagsAndRetains`, `coreDeletedOwnerIgnoredByDuplicateCheck`) pass — `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`, BUILD SUCCESS.
